name: QuantDeus Hermes Evolution
principle: maximal reversible autonomy with observable evidence

chat_bridge.authentication: keyless GitHub Actions OIDC + Vercel project OIDC
chat_bridge.fallback: existing QuantDeus repo-grounded runtime when Hermes Cloud PC is unavailable

browser.account_registration: allowed for legitimate QuantDeus project-service accounts until a human-verification or commitment gate

scheduler.action: legacy Hermes cron scripts/routes retained for archive compatibility only

self_improvement.custom_mcp_rule: inspect provenance and scope first; if it can mutate external systems or needs new credentials, create an auditable setup/handoff instead of fabricating access

self_modification.profile_tool_and_mcp_configuration: autonomous when reversible and credentials already exist
self_modification.guardrail_changes: must not be silently weakened by an agent

account_registration.allowed_use: project accounts required for an active QuantDeus task
account_registration.identity: use a truthful QuantDeus project/service identity; no impersonation or bulk account farming
account_registration.credentials: store only in approved runtime secret storage or browser vault, never Issues/PRs
stop_and_handoff: email or SMS verification not already available to the runtime
legal terms requiring a human commitment
account_registration.audit: record only public-safe result/status and link it to a canonical task

human_gates: sensitive external outreach or promises of employment/equity/payment
